SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales,
  s.sqm,
  s.region,
  s.format
FROM dim_store s
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON s.store_key = f.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm, s.region, s.format
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) as earliest_sale,
  MAX(sale_date) as latest_sale
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code != 'WB' OR channel_id != 0

  s.store_name,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales

INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON s.store_key = f.store_key

WHERE s.store_id < 900 
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT 
  store_id,
  COUNT(*) as version_count
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id < 900
GROUP BY store_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY version_count DESC

SELECT 
  store_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_name) as name_count,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT store_name, ' | ') as store_names
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id < 900
GROUP BY store_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT store_name) > 1

WITH store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.store_id,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as net_sales
  FROM dim_store s
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT 
  ss.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  ss.net_sales
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = ss.store_id AND s.is_current = true
ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
